Both supplied units are base_text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 782-1016 and 1017-1310). No patch hunks or head_text were provided, so the PR's actual change is not visible and cannot be cited. CHANGELOG.md is documentation only, with no executable or authorization behavior. A finding needs a visible changed line, and none exists, so findings=[].

The base text contains security-relevant release notes that a reviewer of the other files in this PR should check against the code and the threat model:
- App Attest protocol 3 and serving authorization (TB-011, T-052..T-058): changelog lines ~836-847 and ~876-887.
- SSD prefix cache disk budget and TTL (T-041): ~1004 and ~1134. The changelog still says a 100 GiB ceiling in the older entry at line 1134, while the threat model now says half of available disk with no fixed ceiling. The cache TTL of 30 minutes (since 2026-09-26) is not visible in these units. A mismatch between code and docs would be a documentation drift to verify, not a finding here.
- Provider cache epoch rotation and eviction (~862).
- Coordinator-authored cache scope (T-041, SEC-035), not shown in these units.
- Profiler tables and fleet snapshots, which are prompt-free (T-051): ~1278-1310.
- A self_route_only key-minting behavior change (~847), relating to API key scope (T-004).
- Free-token grants and payouts, relating to payment and billing atomicity (TB-008): ~786-790.

Coverage limit: unchanged callers and source code were not supplied. Integration should examine the non-changelog files in this PR for the actual security-relevant diffs.
